package.description: WGC is a game launcher app that lets you keep all your Wargaming games in one place.

en-GB.longDescription:
Wargaming.net Game Centre is the official game launcher for all Wargaming titles.
It provides a unified platform to download, install, update, and manage games like World of Tanks, World of Warships, and World of Warplanes.
The launcher features automatic game updates, news feeds, and easy access to your Wargaming account.
en-GB.name: Wargaming.net Game Centre
